result.summary: Fixes an intermittent functional test failure in p2p_tx_download.py. It mocks time on nodes[1] alongside nodes[0] during test_block_inv and resets mocktime when the subtest completes.
result.problem: In test_block_inv, nodes[1] did not have its time mocked. If wall-clock time advanced by 2 seconds before nodes[0] delivered a transaction announcement, nodes[1] would request the transaction from an unresponsive test peer instead, never receive the transaction, and cause sync_mempools() to fail.
evidence: Commit e556dc1ef1 and PR description: 'Because nodes[1] time was not mocked in test_block_inv, it was possible for wall clock to advance 2s by the time nodes[0] had delivered a tx announcement to it. Then, nodes[1] would request the tx from a test peer, never receive the tx, and fail in sync_mempools().'
result.changed_since_previous: Diff provided matches the previous description; no changes to PR contents.
result.card: Fixes an intermittent failure in the p2p_tx_download.py functional test by applying mocktime to nodes[1] in test_block_inv. Without mocked time, wall-clock progression can advance past transaction download retry timers, causing nodes[1] to request a transaction from an unresponsive test peer and fail during mempool synchronization. This stabilizes CI and functional test runs.

risk.why: Touches only functional test mocktime handling, which cannot affect production behavior or node binaries.
